stories.headline: Cutter Tampa lands roughly 13 tonnes of cocaine and 1.5 tonnes of marijuana at Port Everglades from six Pacific interdictions
stories.body: The Coast Guard cutter unloaded about 29,600 pounds of cocaine and 3,355 pounds of marijuana in Florida on October 14, with a stated value near $226.7 million. The drugs came from six interdictions in the eastern Pacific under Operation Pacific Viper; reporting did not give detainee numbers or interdiction dates.
